posts.title: Odd Cats Combat & Injury Table
posts.description: When an Odd Cat engages in battle they make a STR or NIM save, their preference. The referee will roll an opposing save using the enemy cat's stats. Odd Cats may make a SPI save to bolster their attack, a menacing display of hissing and raised fur. If they succeed they roll their next save with advantage. If one cat succeeds and the other fails, the cat that succeeded deals damage to their enemy.
